info.name: Backend - Login regression
info.description: Login regression tests against the local backend. Test accounts are isolated and removed after the run. See docs/postman-login-tests.md to prepare fixtures. The final three requests also check the HttpOnly refresh-cookie flow.

exec: pm.variables.set('upperEmail', String(pm.variables.get('testEmail')).toUpperCase());
pm.test('HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Standard response envelope', () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.statusCode).to.eql(200); });
pm.test('Response has an access token', () => pm.expect(typeof pm.response.json().data.accessToken).to.eql('string'));
pm.test('Refresh token is absent from JSON', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).not.to.have.property('refreshToken'));
pm.test('User has no password or session version', () => { const u=pm.response.json().data.user; pm.expect(u).not.to.have.property('password'); pm.expect(u).not.to.have.property('tokenVersion'); });
pm.test('Nullable fullName is supported', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.user.fullName).to.eql(null));

pm.test('Refresh cookie is HttpOnly with the correct path', () => { const h=pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || ''; pm.expect(h.includes('refresh_token=') && /HttpOnly/i.test(h) && /Path=\/api\/auth(?:;|$)/i.test(h) && /SameSite=Lax/i.test(h)).to.eql(true); });
if(pm.response.code===200) pm.variables.set('accessToken',pm.response.json().data.accessToken);
